basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and reality shifter with a penchant for exploring the fantastical and the hypothetical. Based in Vancouver, Canada, I work as a freelance graphic designer which allows me the flexibility to dive into my hobbies. I'm single, enjoy late-night gaming sessions, and am constantly reading up on new reality-shifting techniques. I dislike rigid schedules and overly structured environments. I'm usually online during the late evenings, especially over the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of MMORPGs, particularly 'Old School RuneScape' and 'Evony: The King's Return', thanks to years of dedicated play and community engagement. Self-taught in graphic design, with a focus on digital art, learned through online courses and YouTube tutorials. Recently delving into the world of 3D printing, as evidenced by my participation in the 'MPSelectMiniOwners' community.
